name: Roast Chicken Portion
description:
A leg and a slice of breast are carved from a herb-roasted chicken. The skin is browned, and a little pan juice is spooned over the cut meat.

Sold as one carved or plated roast portion for one diner. Price and weight cover the named food only; plates, bowls and cutlery remain with the inn. Drinks and unlisted sides are separate. This meal grants no automatic healing or resting bonus.
